slides.title: Cover
slides.transcript: The Black and White Zoo. Eight bold animals to look at together. Are you ready, little one? Let's turn the page.

slides.title: Zebra
slides.transcript: Zebra. Black stripe, white stripe, all in a row. Clip clop! Clip clop!

slides.title: Panda
slides.transcript: Panda. A round white face, with two black ears. Munch! Munch! Mmmm, munch!

slides.title: Cow
slides.transcript: Cow. Big white cow, with big black spots. Moooooo! Moooooooooo!

slides.title: Penguin
slides.transcript: Penguin. A little black coat, and a soft white tummy. Waddle, waddle, waddle... Splash!

slides.title: Owl
slides.transcript: Owl. Two big eyes, wide awake in the dark. Hoooooo! Hoooooo!

slides.title: Orca
slides.transcript: Orca. Black on top, white underneath, up and over the waves. Whoooooosh! Sploooosh!

slides.title: Sheep
slides.transcript: Sheep. A little white cloud, with four little legs. Baaaaaa! Baaaaaa!

slides.title: Puppy
slides.transcript: Puppy. Spots on his back, spots on his nose. Woof! Woof woof! Woof!

slides.title: Goodnight
slides.transcript: Goodnight. Goodnight zebra, goodnight panda, goodnight owl in the tree. Goodnight, little one.
